shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "=== TREE ===" && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100

cat package.json AGENTS.md src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json && echo "=== routing head ===" && sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "=== traps theming ===" && rg -n -C 4 -i 'ThemeProvider|theme' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -120 && echo "=== node_modules uikit ===" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ 2>/dev/null && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>&1 | head -5; echo "=== inspect ==="; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme SegmentedRadioGroup Switch 2>&1 | head -60; echo "=== icons version ==="; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json; echo "=== ThemeProvider d.ts ==="; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts 2>&1; echo "=== theme index ==="; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts

echo "=== SegmentedRadioGroup ==="; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/ 2>&1; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts 2>&1; echo "=== ThemeContext ==="; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeContext.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeType.d.ts; echo "=== Text/Flex ==="; rg -n "variant\?|export type TextProps|TEXT_VARIANTS" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts 2>&1 | head -20; echo "=== jsdom/vitest ==="; ls node_modules | grep -E '^(jsdom|happy-dom)$'; ls vitest.config.* 2>/dev/null; echo "=== online docs ==="; curl -sS -m 20 https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/uikit7.txt; echo "exit=$? size=$(wc -c </tmp/uikit7.txt 2>/dev/null)"; head -c 300 /tmp/uikit7.txt

echo "=== ControlGroupProps ==="; rg -n -A 14 "export interface ControlGroupProps|export interface ControlProps|export interface ControlGroupOption" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; echo "=== theming.md ThemeProvider ==="; rg -n -C 6 "useTheme|ThemeProvider|document.body|theme=" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -120; echo "=== README required setup ==="; rg -n -A 12 -i "Required setup|## Usage" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -40
